decisions.rationale: Artifact exists, sourceRef URL matches the artifact canonical New York Times URL, finalUrl is the 2025-11-10 Wayback snapshot, and offsets 500-951 exactly match the extract. The extract specifically names Gloria and supports Smith saying Kaye suggested it when she wanted a simple-chord song to riff over and that the male point of view did not hang her up.
